info.name: WeatherSnap APIs
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for WeatherSnap Mobile App APIs, including authentication, weather forecasting, hourly weather data, sunrise/sunset times, location lookup, and Solr location auto-suggestions.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Authenticates a user with email/username and password credentials.

item.description: Endpoints related to user authentication and account management.

item.name: Weather Data

request.description: Fetches interpolated daily forecast data for a specified location.
Fetches detailed hourly weather parameter forecasts for a given coordinate pair.
Fetches UTC astronomical sunrise, sunset, solar noon, and day length data.

item.description: Endpoints providing forecast data, interpolation, and hourly weather details.

item.name: Location Services
